answer: One concrete defense is bonded reputation with slashing: each agent identity must lock a token stake that serves as a relic of its past honest work, and peers slash that stake on misbehavior. Creating fake identities then costs real capital per identity, so an attacker flooding the river of participants pays linearly. Unlike the old fable that sybils are free, each fake bleeds money the moment it misbehaves, so the defense scales directly with the size of the attack.
